say:1:1841103001:0.text: Baba may be a little eccentric, but she has a heart of gold.
say:1:1841103001:0.source_cn: 婆婆虽然脾气有些古怪，但其实是个很好的人。
say:1:1841103001:0.male: Baba may be a little eccentric, but she has a heart of gold.

say:2:1841103002:0.text: I think replacing her limbs so many times has left some of her memories a little scrambled.
